mapper.sql: SELECT d.id, d.project_id, d.task_id, d.name, d.category, d.owner_id, o.username AS owner_username, o.real_name AS owner_real_name, d.status, d.current_version, d.due_date, d.finalized_at, d.created_at, d.updated_at FROM document d JOIN sys_user o ON o.id = d.owner_id

SELECT v.id, v.document_id, v.version, v.change_note, v.file_name, v.file_path, v.file_size, v.content_type, v.uploader_id, u.username AS uploader_username, u.real_name AS uploader_real_name, v.created_at FROM document_version v JOIN sys_user u ON u.id = v.uploader_id
mapper.select: SELECT id FROM document WHERE id = #{id} FOR UPDATE
WHERE d.project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY d.id DESC
WHERE d.task_id = #{taskId} AND d.status != 'FINAL' ORDER BY d.id LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document (project_id, task_id, name, category, owner_id, status, current_version, due_date) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{taskId}, #{name}, #{category}, #{ownerId}, #{status}, #{currentVersion}, #{dueDate})
mapper.update: UPDATE document SET current_version = #{currentVersion} WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE document SET status = 'FINAL', finalized_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: WHERE v.document_id = #{documentId} ORDER BY v.id DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM document_version WHERE document_id = #{documentId} AND version = #{version}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO document_version (document_id, version, change_note, file_name, file_path, file_size, content_type, uploader_id) VALUES (#{documentId}, #{version}, #{changeNote}, #{fileName}, #{filePath}, #{fileSize}, #{contentType}, #{uploaderId})
